>Tom or Jennifer,

>How do you ante in Jyhad--does each player agree to ante from one of

crypt.

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
Jennifer Schlickbernd <lorini@netcom.com> wrote:
>>How do you ante in Jyhad--does each player agree to ante from one of
>>their libraries, or what?
>You ante at the beginning of the game from your library, *not* from your
>crypt.  

Though you could ante from your crypt if everyone agreed to it...  as always,
you can use any ante variants you feel like.  But yes, the rules say you
ante from the library, not from the crypt.

Messages.Author: David Q. Spitzley
Messages.Body:
I think a reasonable ante variant would be to allow each player to flip 
one card from both their library and their crypt and pick which to ante 
(it provides some minimal insurance against royal hose jobs).
